project.name: Kore Health
project.description: Kore Health — a ring-wearable health companion (Expo / React Native, Oura ring over BLE). French Porcelain base, Umbra ink, and brand-filled summary cards (sage, Penna, periwinkle, Hudson) tiled with tight 6pt gutters; white cards hold charts and lists. Summary first on home; charts and ranges are disclosed on each detail screen.

boards.name: Primitives
boards.description: @kore/ui design system: brand palette tokens (French Porcelain, Hudson, Penna, Country Rubble, Farmer's Market, Umbra), sentence-case type with an 11pt floor, flat brand-filled and white cards, and the governed primitives screens compose.

boards.name: Screens
boards.description: The Kore user journey on one page. Each row is one route, read top to bottom in the order a person meets it (home, pairing, score details, trends, metric details, debug); columns read left to right as that route's states, from first run to fully populated.
